content_sections.heading: About DFS Goa
content_sections.text: The Directorate of Forensic Sciences (DFS) is part of the Department of Home, Government of Goa. It is based at Verna-Goa 403722, near Verna Police Station in Salcete. Its staff examine evidence in the Directorate's laboratory divisions, visit crime scenes across the State of Goa and give evidence in courts. The Directorate's phone number is + 91 (0832) 2782170 and its email is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Submission address: Directorate of Forensic Sciences, Near Verna Police Station, Verna, Salcete, Goa, 403722 The form is addressed to The Director, Directorate of Forensic Sciences, Verna-Goa. 403722. Its subject line reads "Application for the post of ........ on contract basis at the Directorate of Forensic Sciences, Verna-Goa". Write the name of the post you are applying for in the blank. Fill in every field of the Annexure-B form: your name in block letters, father's or husband's name, postal address, mobile number and email ID, nationality, date of birth, gender and Employment Registration No. State whether you have qualified FACT / FACT+ (Forensic Aptitude and Caliber Test). Enter your educational qualifications: degree, year of passing, university or board, and percentage of marks with division or grade. Enter your experience: name of the laboratory, organisation or institution, the post you held, the nature of the work, and the from, up-to and total period. If the space is not enough, you may attach a separate sheet. Affix a recent passport size photograph in the space provided and self-attest it. Sign the declaration and the bottom of the form, and fill in the place and date. Attach the enclosures listed below and submit the form at the Directorate by hand or by post so that it reaches before the due date. Submit a separate application for each post. Applications in any form received after the due date will be summarily rejected, and the candidate will not be told. The notice says that no correspondence or telephone enquiries will be entertained. Each contract lasts one year or until the regular posts are filled, whichever is earlier, and ends automatically after one year unless terminated earlier. content_sections.heading: DFS Goa Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: All contract staff must visit crime scenes in the State of Goa (24x7) at any time, including Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. Visit crime scenes in the State of Goa (24x7) at any time, including Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. Oversee the operations of the forensic team, and assign, review and evaluate the work of scientific staff and technicians. Ensure accurate and reliable forensic analyses, maintaining quality assurance and following established protocols. Prepare the reports and documentation of crime scene visits. Give evidence in the Court of Law as an expert witness. Do any other work given by superiors. Overall, ensure that forensic operations are conducted efficiently, accurately and ethically, while also managing the personnel involved. Assist senior officers in examining, evaluating and comparing evidence received in the concerned division of the Directorate, and help with research, development and practical demonstrations for training and visitors. Visit crime scenes to assist senior officers and Investigating Officers (I.Os) round the clock on calls from Police Stations/Units/PCR, and collect, document and submit crime scene visit reports and physical evidence in the prescribed formats. Manage exhibits from receipt, storage, opening and analysis to packing, sealing and dispatch. Maintain laboratory equipment, logbooks, AC/cold storage units, and inventories of consumables, glassware, chemicals and miscellaneous items, promptly reporting faults and managing procurement procedures. Maintain registers and records of crime scene visits, pending exhibits, monthly returns/reports and laboratory activities. Do any other work given by superiors. Visit crime scenes in the State of Goa (24x7) at any time, including Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. Assist the Scientific Officer (SOC) in collecting fingerprint evidence from crime scenes. Ensure accurate and reliable fingerprint examination, maintaining quality assurance and following established protocols. Assist the Scientific Officer (SOC) in preparing the reports and documentation of crime scene visits. Give evidence in the Court of Law as a witness. Do any other work given by superiors. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: document scrutiny, then an interview. The Directorate will scrutinise the applications received. The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the Goa Govt. Portal (https://www.goa.gov.in/citizen/recruitment/). Interviews will be held at the Directorate of Forensic Sciences, Verna-Goa. If an interview cannot be completed on the scheduled date or within the scheduled time, it will continue on the next working day. Bring the original documents listed above. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The names of selected candidates will be displayed on the Goa Govt. Portal and sent to them by email and post. Selected candidates must be ready to join immediately. Before appointment, they must sign a contract agreement accepting the terms and conditions on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs.100/-. They must also submit an undertaking that they will not claim regularisation of service or file a court case for it in any Court of Law.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DFS Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 24 vacancies: Scientific Officer (SOC) 05, Scientific Assistant (DNA) 01, Scientific Assistant 05, Searcher (SOC) 01, Photographer 03 and Videographer 09.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DFS Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Directorate of Forensic Sciences, Verna, by 17 November 2026, within the working-day timings that end at 5.30 p.m. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the DFS Goa Scientific Officer (SOC) post?
faq.answer: You need a Master of Science in Forensic Science/ Chemistry/ Zoology/ Microbiology/ Genetics/ Biotechnology/ Physics with at least second class. You also need at least 02 years' practical experience at a State/Central Forensic Science Laboratory, knowledge of Konkani and Computer, and the prescribed physical and vision standards.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for DFS Goa posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs.60,800/- for Scientific Officer (SOC) and Rs.48,800/- for Scientific Assistant (DNA) and Scientific Assistant. It is Rs.39,000/- for Searcher (SOC) and Rs.22,300/- for Photographer and Videographer. No allowance or facility available to regular employees is payable.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for DFS Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-B application form and attach self-attested copies of your highest qualification's marksheet and certificate, plus your experience certificate. Affix a self-attested photograph, sign the form and deliver it by hand or post to the Directorate of Forensic Sciences, Near Verna Police Station, Verna, Salcete, Goa, 403722.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for DFS Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications go through document scrutiny, and the shortlisted candidates' list appears on the Goa Govt. Portal. Shortlisted candidates are then interviewed at the Directorate of Forensic Sciences, Verna-Goa.

faq.question: Q7. Is the DFS Goa job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely contractual, for one year or until the regular posts are filled, whichever is earlier. Selected candidates must give an undertaking that they will not claim regularisation of service.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one post in DFS Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice requires a separate application for each post.

faq.question: Q9. Is knowledge of Konkani required for DFS Goa posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Konkani is an essential qualification for all six posts, and knowledge of Marathi is desirable. Only for Scientific Officer (SOC) does the notice allow the Government to relax the Konkani requirement, on the Departmental Selection Committee's recommendation, if no suitable candidates with Konkani are available.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the DFS Goa interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for the interview, which will be held at the Directorate of Forensic Sciences, Verna-Goa.
